**How do you know if you have a disability?**
 A Disability Is a Condition That Substantially Limits One Or More Of Your “major Life Activities.” If You Have Or Have Ever Had Such a Condition, You Are a Person With a Disability. Disabilities Include, But Are Not Limited To
   

  

* Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally)
* Autoimmune disorder, for example, lupus, fibromyalgia, rheumatoid arthritis, HIV/AIDS
* Blind or low vision
* Cancer (past or present)
* Cardiovascular or heart disease
* Celiac disease
* Cerebral palsy
* Deaf or serious difficulty hearing
* Diabetes
* Disfigurement, for example, disfigurement caused by burns, wounds, accidents, or congenital disorders
* Epilepsy or other seizure disorder
* Gastrointestinal disorders, for example, Crohn's Disease, irritable bowel syndrome
* Intellectual or developmental disability
* Mental health conditions, for example, depression, bipolar disorder, anxiety disorder, schizophrenia, PTSD
* Missing limbs or partially missing limbs
* Mobility impairment, benefiting from the use of a wheelchair, scooter, walker, leg brace(s) and/or other supports
* Nervous system condition, for example, migraine headaches, Parkinson’s disease, multiple sclerosis (MS)
* Neurodivergence, for example, attention\-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), autism spectrum disorder, dyslexia, dyspraxia, other learning disabilities
* Partial or complete paralysis (any cause)
* Pulmonary or respiratory conditions, for example, tuberculosis, asthma, emphysema
* Short stature (dwarfism)
* Traumatic brain injury

Ladd Partners is a full service Certinia, Rootstock and Salesforce consultancy. We are looking for an intelligent and energetic Software Developer to take a role on our growing team. This is a full\-time employment position working as a remote billable consultant at Ladd Partners.
   

  

 The Software Developer reports to the Director of Software Development. They understand both Salesforce and Certinia products, features, and best practices. They work directly with internal consultants and other more senior developers to analyze requirements and recommend solutions. The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a fast paced environment across multiple projects to deliver the best solution to our clients.

**Who You'll Work With**
 The Activity Apps team builds and operates Nike Run Club (NRC) and Nike Training Club (NTC) \- the mobile experiences that move millions of Nike athletes through runs, workouts, training plans, and guided coaching every day. As a Software Engineer 2 on Android, you'll be a growing IC on a feature squad, partnering daily with senior Android engineers, iOS peers, backend engineers, Product, Design, and QA. This role reports to an Engineering Manager for Activity Apps and works alongside the Principal and Lead engineers who will invest in your growth.
   

  

**Who We Are Looking For**
 Nike is seeking a Software Engineer 2 on Android who has shipped in a real consumer app, is comfortable in modern Android, and is ready to grow into more complex ownership. You'll take on well\-scoped features and pieces of larger initiatives, write clean and testable Kotlin, and lean into the mentorship the team offers. The ideal candidate cares about craft, moves fast without cutting corners, and is curious about how the app actually behaves in an athlete's hand.
   

  

**What You Bring**
* 2\+ years of professional Android development experience shipping consumer\- facing apps
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; will accept any suitable combination of education, experience and training
* Proficiency in Kotlin, including Coroutines and Flow; working knowledge of the modern Android stack (Jetpack Compose, Hilt/Dagger, Room, WorkManager, Navigation)
* Understanding of Android architecture patterns (MVVM, MVI) and how features are structured in a multi\-module codebase
* Familiarity with the Android systems activity apps rely on \- location, sensors, foreground services, lifecycle, audio focus, push \- and willingness to go deep in the areas you own
* Comfort consuming REST/GraphQL APIs and handling offline, low\-bandwidth, and error states gracefully
* Experience writing unit and UI tests (JUnit, Compose UI tests, Espresso)
* Familiarity with Gradle, CI/CD, and the Google Play release process
* Strong debugging habits and an interest in growing them \- profiling, memory analysis, ANR/crash triage
* Collaborative mindset; clear communicator in code review, design discussion, and written docs
* Experience with Spec Driven Development leveraging LLM coding agents and autonomous build and review loops


**What You'll Work On**
 You'll build features in NRC or NTC on Android alongside more senior engineers who will help you take on progressively more complex work. Your code will run in the hands of millions of athletes.
   

  

* Implement features in the NRC or NTC Android app \- from spec through shipped release \- with guidance from senior engineers on the squad
* Own the Android side of well\-scoped feature work and contribute pieces of larger, cross\-platform initiatives
* Write clean, testable, idiomatic Kotlin and uphold the team's quality bar in code review
* Contribute to the workout session stack on Android and adjacent surfaces (sensors, background execution, storage, upload) as you build depth in this area
* Instrument features for observability and experimentation; learn from production behavior and iterate
* Participate in on\-call rotation for app stability; help triage crashes, ANRs, and consumer\-reported issues on Android
* Learn and adopt Android best practices and platform updates that improve the athlete experience
* Adopt AI\-native development practices on the Android team \- internal AI tooling, code assistance, evaluation harnesses \- and share what's working NIKE, Inc. is a growth company that looks for team members to grow with it.


**Position Location \& Schedule**
 This position is based at our incredibly beautiful worldwide campus headquarters location in Beaverton, Oregon. You'll work a "4/1 hybrid" schedule \- Mondays \- Thursdays are in the office and it's optional if you'd like to work Fridays from the Nike campus office or your home office.
